senses.gloss: m. (denom. of בַּד II) olive-treader, workingman in the olive press.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 19b:4">Sabb. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>שמן של ב׳ וכ׳</he> the oil (remnants in corners) belonging to the pressers, and the mats which they use.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 119a:3">B. Kam. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>והב׳ לוקחין מהן וכ׳</he> (read <he>מנשותיהן</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40) you may buy from the oil pressers’ (Rashi: oil producers’) wives &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 1:10">Tosef. Maasr. I, 10</cite> <he>הב׳</he> (<cite ref="E00000"><he>ה</he></cite>)<he>מדליקין וכ׳</he> the oil pressers who take their lighting oil (alternately) from one press and another.
